rationale: [possible conflict event|king zora|unlocks] Not a conflict: King Zora moves aside in Zora's Domain (checklist) and the passage he uncovers leads to Zora's Fountain where Jabu-Jabu waits (gf1, gf3#31). Same event, two halves of it.

[possible conflict quest|running man|sold at] Not a conflict: the Running Man stands in Hyrule Field (checklist) and buys the Bunny Hood for 500 Rupees (gf1#351), which fills Link's wallet. Location and item, not two values.

[possible conflict transition|lost woods|leads to] Not a conflict: the Lost Woods connect to several places (Forest Stage, Kokiri Forest, Goron City, Sacred Forest Meadow, Zora's River). Each fact names a different exit.

[possible conflict missable|deku nut upgrade|missable after] Compatible: the checklist says the Forest Stage nut upgrade is lost once Link grows up; the RA comments add that both Lost Woods Deku upgrades must be taken before the adult trading sequence (Poacher's Saw). The route takes both as Young Link, before the Master Sword, which satisfies both.
[possible conflict transition|broken bridge|leads to] Not a conflict: two different broken bridges, one in Gerudo Valley (Epona jump) and one in Death Mountain Crater (Hookshot).

[possible conflict npc|mido|requires] Not a conflict: two different encounters with Mido. In Kokiri Forest he wants the Kokiri Sword and Deku Shield before the Deku Tree; in the Lost Woods he lets Link pass after Saria's Song.
[possible conflict event|link|unlocks] Not a conflict: different songs at different events (Bolero of Fire in the crater; Nocturne of Shadow in Kakariko after the third adult temple).
[possible conflict event|windmill|triggers] Same event in all sources: the Song of Storms in the Kakariko windmill drains the well. Values are wording only.
